title: Printing Press
description: Adds the printing press which prints your books
body:
### Are you tired of copying books every time you wanted a copy?

This datapack adds the Printing Press, a new block that prints your books so you don't have to!!

![image block](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/99c2556ee1a7bf358efa9e7e52192b327cf05c68.png)

To craft the Printing Press, you need 6 logs of any type, a piston and a block of iron

![recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/2d67c2e8e66a859b16f869be2332909f6d097350_0.webp)
